title: Reverse Bits
statement_short: Reverse bits of a given 32-bit unsigned integer.
constraints: The input must be a binary string of length 32
hint: Fixed 32-bit input length dictates an O(1) bitwise shift and bitwise OR extraction algorithm.
why_not: Right: Bit Manipulation shifts bits right and constructs the reversed integer by shifting left and applying bitwise OR in O(1) time. Not Math / Geometry: Decimal modular division works, but bitwise shifts directly operate on binary bit representations. Not Two Pointers: Converting to a string and reversing pointers takes extra allocation compared to in-place bitwise operations. Not Stack: Pushing bits onto a stack takes auxiliary memory, whereas bitwise operations run in O(1) space.
